        return base_inventory

    # Reinforcement-inspired reward calculation
    reward = 0.0

        prev_inv = history_inventory[i-1]

        lost = history_lost[i] if i < len(history_lost) else 0
        reward = reward * reward_decay + (current_inv - lost) - (prev_inv * holding_cost)
    
    # Dynamic cost-aware threshold

    dynamic_threshold = base_inventory * (1 + cost_ratio * cluster_ratio)
    
    # Lead-time compensated target

    target = dynamic_threshold + lead_time_adjustment + (reward * 0.01)
    order_amount = max(0, target - current_inventory)
    
    return order_amount
